shell.access.hint: Kwabantu abasebenzisa umfundi wesikrini, ikhibhodi nomsindo. Ukukhetha okukodwa kuzo zonke izicelo kulesi sisiphequluli. Lokhu akuthumeli umsindo noma inkulumo noma kuphi.
shell.access.kit.focus: Isikhombi sekhibhodi. Izinkinobho zomcibisholo zihambisa, Enter ukhetha, Tab uya kokulandelayo eduze, uphawu lombuzo lunikeza uhlu lokhiye.

Tab kanye Shift Tab baya kokulandelayo noma kokwedlule eduze. D uchaza imbonho. W utshela lapho ukhona. N uhlu lokuseduze. S ushiwo okukhethiwe. R ushiwo futhi. V uvula noma uvala izwi. shell.ask.noroute: Asikho i-AI exhunyiwe okwamanje. Xhuma enye ku-CadCraft Studio › Xhuma i-AI yakho, noma engeza ukhiye wakho noma imodeli yasendaweni ezilungiselelweni › Abasizi.
shell.ask.note: Izimpendulo zingumbhalo oyinhloko. I-AI ibona okubuyiswa yizithulusi zayo kuphela, nemvume yakho inquma ukuthi ingashintsha ini. Uma ukhethe i-AI yefu, okubuyiswa yizithulusi kuya kumhlinzeki wayo.

shell.dev.ms.hint: Inkinobho ecaleni eyisethelwe umyalo akusaphindisi isiphequluli ikhasi elidlule. Isondo nezinye izinkinobho zitholakala kwi-Imenyu, izinkinobho nemouse yohlelo.
shell.dev.noview: {app} akikaphenyisi imibono yayo, ngakho imouse ye-3D, isilawuli noma inobhu akukwazi ukushintsha umbono lapha. Izinkinobho zayo zisasebenza imiyalo.

shell.dev.pen.moved: Inkinobho ecaleni likapeni, uhlangothi lwayo lokusula nokuthinta ngeminwe kusethelwa ku-Amadivayisi okufaka, lapho zingenza noma yimuphi umyalo.
shell.dev.scope.all.hint: Okushintshwayo lapha kusebenza kuyo yonke i-app engenazilungiselelo zamadivayisi okufaka zayo.

shell.dev.sm.hint: Xhuma kanye; isiphequluli sikhumbula imouse ye-3D yale ndawo. Ishintsha umbono ngaphansi kwesikhombi, uma kungenjalo owasetshenziswa ekugcineni.
shell.dev.sm.why.nohid: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukufinyelela imouse ye-3D. Sebenzisa i-Chrome noma i-Edge, noma uhlelo lwedeskithophu.
shell.dev.tp.hint: I-trackpad ihlukaniswa nevili yemouse ngokuthi iskrola kanjani. Isivinini nokuqondisa kusebenza uma uhlelo lushintsha umbono ngokwalo.

shell.engines.des.name: Imigqa yokulinda nokulingisa ukugeleza
shell.engines.des.summary: Ukulingiswa kwemigqa yokulinda, abasebenzi, izibhamuluzi namashifu, nokuphindwa kwezilinganiso.
shell.engines.em.name: Amasekethe nezinkambu
shell.engines.em.summary: Isixazululi sesekethe sohlu lwezixhumanisi: indawo yokusebenza, ukuskena, i-AC kanye ne-transient.
shell.engines.live.name: Idatha ephilayo
shell.engines.live.summary: Abahlanganisi bemilayezo ye-Modbus, MQTT ne-BACnet nesitolo sethegi esinezimaki (ukufunda kuphela).
shell.engines.motion.name: Ukunyakaza namarobhothi
shell.engines.motion.summary: Amaketango arobhothi, i-kinematics eqondile nebuyela emuva, ama-torque amalunga, izindlela, i-URDF ngaphakathi nangaphandle; amalunphu avaliwe aphansi (i-four-bar, i-slider-crank, amarobhothi ahambisanayo) nezilinganiso zesivinini nezigaba ze-Grashof.
shell.engines.network.name: Amanethiwekhi aphayipi namasistimu kagesi
shell.engines.network.summary: Ukugeleza kwamanethiwekhi aphayipi nengcindezi, ukulayisha kukagesi, isekhethi emfushane, amajika okuvikela.
shell.engines.pcb.name: Amabhodi
shell.engines.pcb.summary: Beka futhi uhlele ibhodi kusuka ohlwini lokuxhumana, hlola imithetho yokwakha, bhala i-Gerber ne-IPC-2581.
shell.engines.plc.name: Ukulawula (PLC)
shell.engines.plc.summary: Umbhalo ohlelekile we-IEC 61131-3: uwuhlole, uwuskene, ubuke izinto eziguquguqukayo.
shell.engines.risk.name: Ingozi nokuthembeka
shell.engines.risk.summary: Izihlahla zokungaphumeleli, amabhlokhi okuthembeka, i-FMEA, ukulinganiswa kwe-Weibull, amamodeli e-Markov.
shell.engines.schedule.name: Ishejuli nezindleko
shell.engines.schedule.summary: Indlela ebucayi enemisebenzi yokulibazisa namakhalenda, izinsiza, ijika lezindleko nenani elitholakele.
shell.engines.schematic.name: Izikimu nokuxhumana
shell.engines.schematic.summary: Izimpawu, amaphini, amanethi, intambo namanani amatheminali, izinkomba, amapulani, uhlu lwezinto nezinhlolo zemithetho eyishumi nambili.
shell.engines.sys.name: Amasistimu (amamodeli ahlanganisiwe)
shell.engines.sys.summary: Amamodeli angenasizathu ezizindaweni zikagesi, zokushisa, zamanzi nezomshini; isifundi sesibonelo se-Modelica.
shell.engines.title: Izinjini
shell.engines.trace.name: Izidingo nokulandelwa
shell.engines.trace.summary: Izidingo ezixhunyiwe ezintweni nasezivivinyweni, imatrikisi yokumboza, umthelela, i-ReqIF ngaphakathi nangaphandle.
shell.engines.what: Sebenzisa enye yezinjini ezabelwanayo kumodeli oyinamathisela noma esinye sezibonelo ezisebenzile. Konke kusebenza kulo khasi; akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi. Izinkinga zivela nakupaneli Yezinkinga.
shell.env.full: Sesinezilungiselelo ezingu-{n} ngaphambili; susa eyodwa kuqala.
shell.env.hint: Londoloza yonke isethi yakho ngegama (isakhiwo, isitayela semenyu nokhiye, ithuluzi, amaphaneli namathuluzi ami, kuzo zonke izinhlelo) bese uyashintsha phakathi kwezilungiselelo. Itimu nolimi kuhlala njengoba kunjalo.

shell.env.nostore: Lesi siphequluli asikwazanga ukukugcina (isitoreji sigcwele noma sivaliwe).
shell.fields.button.title: Amaphakhethi wensimu: lungisa le app ukuze isebenze ensimini yakho

shell.fit.done: Isakhiwo siqiniwe: amathuluzi manje athatha {n}% wobude bewindi. Shintsha noma nini ku-Izilungiselelo.
shell.fit.fine: Amathuluzi ashiya umdwebo indawo eyanele kule window.
shell.fit.full.hint: Cindezela F11 ukuze uthole isikrini esigcwele.
shell.fit.more.1: Izilungiselelo › Imigqa yamathuluzi: goqa ukuze kwaneliswe, imigqa emibili, noma umugqa owodwa oskrolela ngasohlangothini.
shell.fit.more.2: Izilungiselelo › Izinkinobho zamathuluzi: izithonjana namagama, izithonjana kuphela noma amagama kuphela. Iribhoni igoqeka ibe ngamagama amathebhu ngemenyu yokuchofoza ngesokudla.
shell.fit.more.3: Isikrini esigcwele (F11, noma inkinobho ekhoneni elingaphezulu) sifihla amabha ebhrawuza futhi sibuyisele iwindi ubude balo. Ukunciphisa ikhasi (Ctrl no-minus) nakho kuyasiza.
shell.fit.more.4: Ukhethe Ungabuzi futhi ngephutha? Vula ipaleti yomyalo uqalise "Hlola ukulingana kwesakhiwo", noma sula idatha yale site yokhiye cc-fit.
shell.fit.more.lead: Izindlela ezintathu zokunika umdwebo indawo engaphezulu:
shell.fit.never.said: Kulungile, akusayi imibuzo mayelana nesakhiwo. Izilungiselelo zisenazo zonke izinketho zesakhiwo.
shell.fit.nothing: Isakhiwo sase sesiqinile ngangokunokwenzeka. Zama isikrini esigcwele (F11) noma ukunciphisa ikhasi.
shell.fit.offer: Shintshela ekwakheni okuqinile? Amathuluzi azophuma ngomugqa owodwa oskrolayo, iribhoni igoqeke ibe ngamagama amathebhu, nezinkinobho zilahlekelwe amagama uma lokho kunganeli. Ungakushintsha futhi kuZilungiselelo.
shell.fit.offer.cmdline: Umugqa womyalo nawo wehla ube ngumugqa owodwa uma umdwebo usafinyelela; i-F2 ibonisa umlando wawo.
shell.fit.title: Lo window umfushane kumamenyu akho

shell.ws.mine.nostore: Amathuluzi ami akakwazanga ukugcinwa kulesi sisiphequluli.
shell.ws.ribbon.collapsed: Iribhoni ibonisa amathebhu kuphela: chofoza ithebhu ukuze uthole amathuluzi ayo; chofoza kabili ithebhu ukuze ugcine iribhoni ivulekile.
shell.ws.sel.none: Akukho okukhethiwe. Khetha ithuluzi, noma uchofoze okuthile komdwebo.
shell.ws.standard.hint: Ibha yamathuluzi phezulu, amafayela namaphaneli emodeli ngakwesobunxele, izakhiwo ngakwesokudla.
shell.ws.tear.blocked: Iwindi aliwukwazi ukuvula. Vumela ama-pop-up kule webhusayithi bese uzama futhi.
shell.ws.tear.done: Iribhoni isewindini layo: yihambise lapho ofuna khona, ngisho nasesikrinini esihlukile. Buyisela iribhoni, noma vala leyo windi, ukuze ibuye endaweni yayo.
shell.ws.tear.title: I-ribbon ye-{app}
shell.ws.toolbox.hint: Ikholomu yamathuluzi ngakwesobunxele nebhokisi lolwazi lethuluzi elisebenzayo phezulu: ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo zakudala zokwakha ezi-architect.
shell.ws.vector.hint: Indawo yokudweba yasekhompyutheni yakudala: ibha yemenyu, ibha yokubuka nebha yemodi phezu komdwebo, amaphaneli Okuyisisekelo nAmasethi Amathuluzi ngakwesokunxele, Ulwazi Lwento nokuzula ngakwesokudla, amathebhu emidwebo nomugqa wokuxhumanisa.
shell.ws.sketch.hint: Indawo yokumodela ye-3D yabantu abadweba futhi bagxobhoze/bahudule: imenyu kusuka ku-Ifayela kuya ku-Usizo, imigqa yezithonjana zamathuluzi phezu komdwebo, ikholomu encane yamathuluzi omdwebo ngakwesokunxele, ithreyi ngakwesokudla enolwazi lwento, amathebhu emidwebo nomugqa wesimo.
shell.ws.why.full: Ukulungiswa okungu-8 sekuvele kungeniswe; susa elilodwa kuqala
shell.ws.why.nothing: akukho zakhiwo zalo ezifanele lesi sicelo
shell.newhere.title: Ngingumsha…
shell.newhere.offer: Usha ukuhlala ku-{app}? Thatha uhambo lwemizuzu emithathu lwawo amahlelo, izilungiselelo nokuthi ungasizwa kuphi.
shell.newhere.welcome.p: Lolu hambo luthatha cishe imizuzu emithathu. Lukukhombisa i-{app} nomndeni wonke, bese luveza lapho okushintshwa khona izinto nalapho ungasizwa khona.
shell.newhere.welcome.apps: Amahlelo ayisishiyagalombili, nokuthi yiwuphi ofanele umsebenzi wakho
shell.newhere.welcome.help: Usizo, izifundo, izifundiso nokuthi ubuze bani
shell.newhere.welcome.skip: Ungaphuma noma nini. Uyithole futhi ngaphansi kwe-Usizo › Ngingumsha….
shell.newhere.task.markup: Maka futhi wenze ukubuyekeza kwama-PDF nemidwebo
shell.newhere.task.takeoff: Linganisa amanani futhi ubeke amanani emisebenzi
shell.newhere.apps.p: Uhlelo ngalunye lwenza uhlobo olulodwa lomsebenzi, futhi onke ayabelana ngesakhiwo esifanayo, amafayela nomtapo. Qala ngaleyo elifanele umsebenzi wakho.
shell.newhere.apps.note: Ukuvula uhlelo kusebenzisa ithebhu entsha, ngakho umsebenzi wakho lapha uhlala njengoba unjalo.
shell.newhere.app.cadcraft: Ukudweba kwe-2D ngomugqa womyalo, nge-DWG ne-DXF.
shell.newhere.app.bimcraft: Vula, hlola, hlela futhi ubuyekeze amamodeli wezakhiwo.
shell.newhere.app.markupcraft: Maka, linganisa futhi ubuyekeze ama-PDF nemidwebo.
shell.newhere.settings.p: Izilungiselelo zigcina izinqumo zakho kule khompyutha. Ezimbalwa abantu abasha abavame ukuzishintsha:
shell.newhere.settings.layout.what: Indlela amathuluzi namaphaneli ahlelwe ngayo. Ungakushintsha futhi kamuva, kuwo wonke amahlelo noma kwelilodwa.
shell.newhere.settings.tours: Qala uhambo lokuqala lwesicelo ngasinye ngokwaso
shell.newhere.settings.l1: Ithebhu ye-{app}: izinketho zalolu hlelo kuphela
shell.newhere.settings.l3: Ukubukeka okukhanyayo noma okumnyama, isitayela sezithonjana nosayizi wombhalo
shell.newhere.settings.l4: Imbewu, upeni, ikhibhodi nezinye izinsiza zokufaka
shell.newhere.settings.none: Izilungiselelo zivula kusuka kwegiya elisesigabeni esiphezulu.
shell.newhere.help.p: Kukhona izindawo eziningi zokufunda nokubuza. Cindezela Bonisa ukuze uvule enye.
shell.newhere.help.panel.what: Izihloko zalolu hlelo, ezingasakwa. Cindezela {key} noma nini. Ivula ecaleni komsebenzi wakho.
shell.newhere.help.find.what: Sesha imiyalo, izilungiselelo nosizo kubhokisi elilodwa.
shell.newhere.help.lessons.what: Izifundo ezinyathelo ngezinyathelo ngaphakathi kohlelo, nomeluleki uma ufuna mnye.
shell.newhere.help.about.what: Inguqulo, uhlobo nokuthi Bika inkinga ngezithombe-skrini.
shell.newhere.done.p: Lolo uhambo. Akukho okushintshiwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhethile.
shell.newhere.done.again: Usizo › Ngingumsha… iqalisa lolu hambo futhi
